Full summary: Lane 02c review fixes committed 29d3c82 (11 confirmed + 5 unverified fixed; a re-run-after-recovery defect found and fixed; file-store accepts Buffer). Only lane 02b's fix pass remains before the merge.
Findings: Lane 02c refuted part of R5 but found a worse defect underneath: the post-rollback exemption was derived from the current run's actions, so every re-run after a successful forward recovery failed verification permanently; now derived from the durable id map (origin post_rollback). Committed blob at 52ba50d still holds the NUL so git renders that one diff as binary; the working tree is clean text and a guard test keeps it so.
